chosenApproach: One source tree reconstructed from branch-local approved fixes; shared notification screen merges PTT filtering into responsive unread updates; select one coherent offline cache implementation to avoid mismatched offline lesson storage identifiers. Keep original streaming, security, payments, and release runtime. PR compiled QA first, then exact frozen RC production promotion.
preserveBehaviors: No new native dependency or runtime change; existing app version 1.3.6 code 30 runtime 1.3.2 preserved.
No financial ledger, points redemption, bank/payout or Supabase authentication permission mutation.
PTT SOS/Priority and background receive remain live, routine PTT suppressed only from notifications and foreground noise.

acceptanceChecks: Legacy 41 active tracks remain intact and category browse/search paginates without 120-track cutoff; System Admin can assign folder and retry failed batch entries.
Drag music clip with active preview: seek without reloading or tap Play each movement; song-switch, loop, and pause release contracts.
Circle rank badges persist account progression independent of character resets; rank and character recognition remain separate.
User earnings screens show own estimates/finalized cash only; admin retains detailed accounting, withdrawal follows single canonical wallet.
PTT routine notifications filtered from feed/counter and foreground banners, emergency and priority notifications maintained.
Notifications inbox refreshes on focus/count change; server birthday/welcome dispatcher preserves privacy and idempotent recipient caps.
Bible, Word, and previously authorized lesson texts load offline with bounded re-sync; read-only offline access never awards points.
Mandatory CI typecheck, focused regression contracts, Android and Expo web exports pass on exact PR source.
Freeze verified RC; publish Android production OTA and Expo Hosting web from exact main merge SHA and verify deployment evidence.
selectionRationale: Combine only latest nonconflicting, source-compatible 2026-11-09 fixes so one Android OTA and Expo web update can be compiled and promoted from the same protected SHA; retain independent stable native release and financial ledgers.
alternativeApproaches: Publish all unrelated DEV branches directly into production without one compiled RC (rejected: unresolved overlapping notification and offline lesson cache behavior).
Use the offline-timed alternative plus offline-prefetch files without reconciling different cache key formats (rejected: saved lessons would become inconsistent).
Create a new Expo native AAB for only JavaScript/UI changes (rejected: unnecessary and potentially incompatible with installed V30 runtime).
